description: Set up channels to delete text-messages from

content.name: channelID
content.description: The Channel you want messages to be deleted from.

content.name: timeout
content.description: Timeout (in minutes) after which the messages in a channel will be deleted.

content.name: keepMessageCount
content.description: Set up a number here to always have x messages in your channel left (newest messages are kept). The number has to below 50.
